title: Safe membership change
statement: The system shall keep at most 1 leader per shard per Raft term in 100% of voter membership changes, using joint consensus or single-server changes.
rationale: Single-step multi-voter changes can produce split majorities. New replicas join as learners and are promoted after catch-up.

acceptance_criteria.text: Under the Jepsen-style suite with continuous add/remove of replicas, no two leaders are observed in the same term for a shard.
A newly added replica is not counted as a voter until its log lag is below the configured bound.
